note: Minimal skill taxonomy for FR-B-4 qualification mapping, pulled forward from F9 (Slice 4). Each tag has a Thai label and the substrings that map a raw qualification string to it. When F9 builds the editable taxonomy (FR-G-3) this file moves to packages/seeds/ and the shape may change - `qualifications.value` keeps the raw strings, so only `.tags` is recomputed. Spec 2026-09-09 D10 / §10 Q1.
